title: Governance request gating matrices and response SLOs for enterprise controls
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Create an operational decision framework, intake form template, and routing+SLO playbook to triage enterprise data-governance requests (logging redaction, retention configuration, PII masking, and audit export formats). This ticket captures the PM deliverables: a gating matrix (how requests map to teams and risk), prioritized response SLAs, and concrete examples + runbook snippets for Eng/Sec/Support to execute. This is specifically for non-bug customer requests (policy/config needs, compliance asks, exported audit data requests).
acceptance_criteria: 1) A one-page gating matrix that maps request types to required reviewers (legal/sec/infra/pm) and minimum artifacts. 2) Intake form fields published in Confluence and available in Zendesk/Support templates. 3) Scoring rubric to prioritize backlog with numeric outputs (0-100). 4) SLOs defined: initial ack, triage decision, estimated timeline, implementation ETA. 5) One end-to-end example case (PII redaction for logs) + follow-up playbook. 6) Stakeholder sign-off from Security, Legal, Support, and Infra.
decision_matrix: Columns: request_type, risk_bucket (low/med/high/legal), required_reviewers, minimum_artifacts, auto-approvable?, routing_queue. Example row: logging-redaction, high, [Security, Privacy, Infra], [example logs, dataflow diagram, retention policy desired], false, sec-data-governance. Requests tagged 'retention <=90d' + no PII => auto-route to Infra with 5-business-day SLO. Requests with legal/regulatory note => require Legal review before implementation.
intake_form_template: Fields: customer_name, org_tier, request_summary, affected_products/endpoints, example payloads/log lines, desired behavior, justification (compliance/regulatory/legal), retention window desired, PII present? (yes/no with list), existing configs, urgency, contact reps. Attachments: dataflow diagram (recommended), redaction regex examples. Form will be published as a Confluence template and a Support macro for Zendesk.
prioritization_rubric: Score components (weights): customer_tier (40%), regulatory_impact (25%), security_risk (20%), implementation_complexity (10%), revenue_impact (5%). Example scoring: Enterprise-1 (40) + regulatory (25) + sec-risk high (20) + complexity (4) + rev impact 5 = 94 => P0. Output: numeric score and bucket {P0: 85-100, P1: 65-84, P2: 40-64, P3: <40}. Prioritization automation: inbound form posts webhook to triage service and returns initial score + queue assignment.
routing_map: Queues: support-triage, sec-data-governance, infra-configs, legal-review, pm-backlog. Rules: if PII present OR request touches audit/export => sec-data-governance + legal-review. If retention change <=90d and no PII => infra-configs. If customer_tier >= Enterprise and score>=85 => PM-led expedited lane with 3 business day decision SLO.
escalation_playbook: 1) If no triage decision in ack_SLO window => escalate to PM on-call. 2) If legal clearance pending >7 business days => weekly sync mandated with Legal TPM and customer update. 3) Post-implementation failure (logging gap or missing exports) => incident runbook ENG-IR triggered, but with 'data-governance' tag for Privacy review. Contacts: Security Pager (SEC-PAGER), Legal TPM (legal-tpm@redwood.com), Infra Lead (sre-oncall@redwood.com).
sla_slos: Ack: 8 business hours for Enterprise, 24 business hours for non-Enterprise. Triage decision: 3 business days for high-risk, 7 business days for medium, 14 business days for low. Estimation ETA: within 5 business days of triage decision. Implementation ETA: negotiated with Infra/SRE and PM; expedited lane aims for 10 business days for P0. Communication cadence: status update every 3 business days for active tickets.
examples_and_playbooks: A) Example: Customer requests redaction of IP/Email in request logs. Intake: filled with sample log lines, dataflow diagram attached. Triage: Security rates as medium-high (risk 70), Legal flags one regulatory paragraph. Routing: sec-data-governance + legal-review. Implementation steps: 1) Infra applies server-side redaction transform at ingress layer + config toggle, 2) run canary, 3) validate with provided sample payloads, 4) ship and update customer. B) Example: Audit export request for compliance — requires Legal data-minimization sign-off and PM approval of export schema.
rollout_notes: Rollout plan: 1) Publish Confluence templates + Support macro (week 0). 2) Run internal training (Support + SRE + Security) with 2 sample walkthroughs (week 1). 3) Wire webhook to triage service (ENG-8421) and test with 10 staged tickets (week 2). 4) Full production enablement and retro after 30 days (week 6).
qa_checks: - Verify intake form enforces required artifacts for high-risk requests. - Automated validation rejects forms without example payloads when PII flagged. - Triage webhook returns a numeric score and queue tag with >95% accuracy on sample set. - Ensure SLO alerts fire to PM on-call after ack window misses.
metrics_and_reporting: - Volume of governance requests by type (weekly) - Average time to triage decision (median & 95th) - Percent meeting SLO (ack & decision) - Distribution of priority scores - Post-implementation defects (regressions related to redaction/retention) - CSAT for governance requests (survey after close)
